words.definition: The act of working together to achieve a common goal
words.definationTranslation: एक साझा लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने के लिए एक साथ काम करने की प्रक्रिया

sentence.sentence: The open-source project encouraged collaboration among developers worldwide.

sentence.sentence: Collaboration is key to the success of any open-source project.

words.definition: The act of modifying something to suit individual needs or preferences

words.definition: The act of giving or supplying something to a number of people or places

words.definition: A place or opportunity for discussion, debate, or exchange of ideas

sentence.sentence: The project's forum is active and helpful for troubleshooting.

sentence.sentence: Open-source software gives users the freedom to modify and distribute it.

words.definition: The act of combining different things to form a whole

sentence.sentence: The company is careful about licensing when using open-source software.

words.definition: The act of keeping something in good condition or working order

words.definition: The act of changing or altering something

sentence.sentence: The developer made significant modifications to the open-source project.

words.definition: The quality of being open or transparent in actions or decisions
words.definationTranslation: कार्यों या निर्णयों में खुला या पारदर्शी होने की गुणवत्ता

sentence.sentence: The open-source community values openness and transparency.

sentence.sentence: The company promotes openness in its development processes.

words.definition: The act of taking part or sharing in something

sentence.sentence: The open-source project encourages participation from developers worldwide.

words.definition: A place where things are stored, especially in a computer system

sentence.sentence: The company uses a private repository for its open-source projects.

sentence.sentence: The company takes security seriously in its open-source products.
